lines.english: "Fuaah…"
"Good work, Setsuna! Here, have a drink."
"Io… you too, good work."
"Okay, here's to the Light Music Club's and Class 3-A's success today!"
"Yeah, cheers."
"Sorry for making you do this unscheduled, even though you're already so tired."
"Nah, it's fine. I was the one who ran away yesterday, after all. I'm glad I could make up for it."
"Thanks to you, I heard our sales increased by around 30%. The class rep was so happy I saw him crying a little while ago."
"Ah, ahaha… I'm just glad I could help."
"Your popularity is godlike now, Setsuna. That stage appearance did wonders."
"It was really fun. And it's all thanks to Haruki-kun and Touma-san."
"…Yeah, you really looked like you were having fun. Despite being dragged into it forcefully by Haruki."
"Yup… I'm really glad to have met the two of them. It feels like I've made my best memories with them."
"Since it turned out like this, maybe I should have introduced you to Haruki sooner?"
"Oh, right… you already knew Haruki-kun from before, Io?"
"He's a pretty good guy, but our interests never really overlapped. We never really hung out all that much either."
"Then… do you know if he's ever had a girlfriend?"
"There's no way he did. It's a mystery as to why he took up the guitar, too."
"I see… Is that so… So Haruki-kun and I are the same, huh…?"
"…Well then, thanks for the drink. I'd better go get changed now."
"Heading to Music Room 2?"
"Yeah, Haruki-kun said he'd be waiting there. Touma-san might be there too."
"All right… Later, then."
"Yeah, thanks for everything today. See you tomorrow."
"…Ah, wait a minute, Setsuna!"
"Hm? What is it, Io?"
"Errr, well… This may not be the right time to say this, but…"
"What's wrong? Why are you suddenly being so roundabout with your words?"
"Well, this is… it's kind of hard for someone like me to give this kind of advice, you see…"
"Um, uh-huh?"
"You know, if… if you're really serious about him, I think you'd better hurry up."
"By that, well… I mean, there's no deep meaning behind it, but…"
"Io…"
"Um, was that too unclear? I can explain, when I say 'him,' I mean…"
"You don't have to say it. It's fine."
"What I mean is, I know exactly what you're trying to tell me, Io. Who you mean by 'him', why I should hurry… and of course, what my own feelings are."
"Setsuna…"
"But… it's fine."
"…What do you mean, fine?"
"I'd be fine if we stayed like this. I can't be happier with our current relationship."
"We had so much fun on stage today, so… I want us to keep having fun, just like that, for a little while longer…"
"That's why… I don't want to change. I don't want anyone to change."
"Setsuna…"
"…There's really no deep meaning behind that, okay?"
"Kitahara."
"Kitahara…?"
"You… really like to sleep while I'm playing the piano. Don't you think you're being rude?"
"Mm, mmm…"
"You look so happy… Were you that delighted to be on stage?"
"Well… I was happy, for what it's worth."
"What a defenseless guy…"
"Hey… come on, Kitahara…"
"…! Mm…? Mm, mmm…"
"You're such a boring guy, you know."
"Serious to a fault, always quibbling and bound by rules… So big-headed and sucking up to the teachers… Getting good grades while you're at it and tooting your own horn over it."
"I swear, with how terribly boring you are…"
"It just makes me want to tease you, you know…"
"Mmm…"
"…! Ah… aah…"
"…Zzz. Mm… zzz…"
"I'm… I'm sorry… Sorry, Kitahara… I really did it."
"This is… all your fault, you know?"
"…No, that's not it. I'm sorry, I'm just terrible…"
"But, you know…"
"I can't help myself, okay? …I'm not strong enough to hold myself back like you are."
"I can't believe it… Touma-san…"
